description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the TimesheetDao component within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, containing test methods for various CRUD operations, data retrieval, and business logic related to timesheet management.

classes.name: TimesheetDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the TimesheetDao methods in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates TimesheetDao instance, and populates fixture data.

methods.name: testAddTimesheet
methods.description: Tests adding a new Timesheet entity and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testDuplicateTimesheet
methods.description: Tests detection of duplicate timesheets for a given employee and start date.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Retrieves timesheet action logs and verifies count and class type.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Tests creation and persistence of a TimesheetActionLog entity.

methods.name: testGetMyTimesheets
methods.description: Tests fetching timesheets for an employee within a specific date range.

methods.name: testIsDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks for duplicate timesheet items based on project, activity, and timesheet IDs.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetItem
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a TimesheetItem entity.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemById
methods.description: Fetches a TimesheetItem by IDs and verifies properties.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetById
methods.description: Retrieves a Timesheet by its ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsExceptionCase
methods.description: Ensures that saving invalid TimesheetItems throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Fetches a list of timesheets for an employee based on filter criteria.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of timesheets matching filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetLatestTimesheet
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the latest timesheet for an employee with and without date filters.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReportAndTotalHours
methods.description: Tests fetching timesheet report items and total hours for an employee under various filters.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Tests counting timesheet report items matching specific filters.

methods.name: testTimesheetAvailability
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a timesheet item based on project, timesheet, activity, and date.
